title: fitllm measured fixture
description: One real-world measurement: what a model ACTUALLY consumed on real hardware. Submitted via PR; cross-referenced by the Fit Census as predicted-vs-measured. Measurements are typed: measurementKind says WHAT was measured — resident weights and whole-system peak are different metrics and are compared against different predicted columns.

device.description: Exact census device name, e.g. 'RTX 4090' or 'M5 Max 64GB'. Legacy exception: entries with unconfirmed hardware carry a descriptive string + measurementKind: unknown and intentionally do NOT join the census; new submissions must use exact names.

measuredPeakGB.description: Measured memory. GiB unless `unit` says otherwise. Field name is legacy — `measurementKind` says whether this is a peak or a resident floor.

measurementKind.description: WHAT was measured. idle_resident = model weights resident with no active generation (a FLOOR; e.g. oMLX actual_size, ollama ps) — compare against predicted weights, NOT against predicted total. load_peak = peak during model load. generation_peak = peak during active generation. system_total_peak = whole-device memory peak incl. OS — the only kind directly comparable to fitllm's usedGB (total to run). unknown = legacy/unclear (new submissions should not use this).

unit.description: Unit of measuredPeakGB. GiB = 1024^3 bytes (what nvidia-smi/Activity Monitor/oMLX labels show), GB = 10^9. Omit if the source did not specify.

includesOsReserve.description: true only if the number includes OS/driver/display memory (whole-system measurements). Resident-weights readings are false.

evidenceLevel.description: maintainer_verified = independently checked by maintainers (physical consistency vs HF weight sizes, engine reproduction, raw artifacts). community_unverified = accepted as a plausible claim, not calibration-grade. Reports are claims until verified — engine constants never change on community_unverified evidence alone.

reporter.description: GitHub username of the person who TOOK the measurement. Must be the measurer — third-party relays of someone else's numbers are not accepted (issue #1 lesson).

runtime.description: llama.cpp <version> / ollama <version> / mlx <version> / vllm <version> — version required for reproducibility. Legacy exception: entries whose original report omitted it carry 'unreported ...' and measurementKind: unknown; new submissions must include it.

source.description: URL of the PR or issue containing the full report
